post.summary: Runs one OxQL query and answers a page of rows.
post.description: Reads one entity of this service through a pipeline of stages and answers a page of rows with what is known of their count, or a refusal with a code. The language is described in the OxQL documentation (https://github.com/simplic/oxql/blob/master/src/docs/oxql-query-syntax.md); the limits of this host are published by `GET /OxQL/health`. Send the header `X-OxQL-Contract: 2`; a request without it is read as contract 1 (legacy, see https://github.com/simplic/oxql/blob/master/src/docs/LEGACY.md). Contract 1 is not what this operation describes: its body and answer are the deprecated schemas `OxQLContract1QueryBody` and `OxQLContract1QueryAnswer`.

parameters.name: X-OxQL-Contract
parameters.description:
The contract the request is written for. `2` is the current contract. Absent, empty or `1`
is contract 1 (legacy): another request language and another answer. Any other value is
refused with 400 on the query, batch and explain routes.

parameters.name: X-OxQL-Timing
parameters.description:
`1` or `true` asks for the `timing` member of the answer: where the request's time went
(the database commands, the owners asked, this host's own share). Contract 2 only.

200.description: The page: `items`, `pageInfo` with the cursor to the next page and the count, and `diagnostics` when there are any.

400.description: The request is wrong as written: a refusal with a code per error.

500.description: A fault of the engine; the message names the correlation id of its log line.

504.description: The query did not finish within its time.

post.summary: Runs several OxQL queries in one request.
post.description: Runs the queries in order under one time ceiling and answers each in its place of `results`: a page, or the refusal of that query. The language is described in the OxQL documentation (https://github.com/simplic/oxql/blob/master/src/docs/oxql-query-syntax.md); the limits of this host are published by `GET /OxQL/health`. Send the header `X-OxQL-Contract: 2`; a request without it is read as contract 1 (legacy, see https://github.com/simplic/oxql/blob/master/src/docs/LEGACY.md).

state.description: `exact`: `value` is the count. `atLeast`: `value` is a proven lower bound. `unknown`: the count that was asked for did not finish.

basis.description: In an explain answer: what would have to change for it not to be said.

OxQLDiagnostic.description: Something a caller should know about an answer that did not refuse the request.

errors.description: The reasons, each with a code.

status.description: The HTTP status repeated in the body; only in an answer to a contract 1 request (legacy).

OxQLError.description: A refusal: why a request was not answered.

code.description: The code; codes are stable, messages are not.

stage.description: The index of the stage of the pipeline the error belongs to.

filter.description: The entry of the request's `filter` the error belongs to: its `id`, or its index.

path.description: The path of the entity the error is about.

params.description: Values to render a message from, by code.

basis.description: In an explain answer: what would have to change for the request to run.

valid.description: Whether the query binds and this host can run it.

executable.description: Whether the request can run: `yes`, `never` or `unknown`.

contract.description: The contract the request was read as.

engine.description: The engine's version, contract and the capabilities of this host.

etag.description: The validator of the answer, also sent as the `ETag` header.

revision.description: The revisions of the models the answer was bound against.

cache.description: How long the answer may be kept and whether it is complete.

errors.description: Every error of the query; empty when it is valid.

diagnostics.description: The diagnostics a run of the query would carry, as far as binding knows them.

notes.description: Notes on how the engine reads the query.

entry.description: The entity the query starts at.

stages.description: Per stage of the pipeline: its kind, its status, what it reads and the shape after it.

filter.description: Per entry of the request's `filter`: where it was placed.

aliases.description: The aliases the joins and unwinds of the query create.

types.description: The types the shapes refer to.

rules.description: The rules by which a member can be filtered, sorted, grouped or listed.

flagSets.description: The sets of such flags the types refer to.

result.description: The columns of the rows a run answers.

columnFlags.description: The flags of the result's columns.

owners.description: The services asked for the parts of the query they own, and how each answered.

catalog.description: The entries of the request's `catalog`, described.

plan.description: The bound form and the stages sent to the database; only with `include: ["plan"]`.

advisory.description: What the indexes of the collection do for the query; only with `include: ["indexes"]`.

OxQLExplainAnswer.description: The answer to an explain. The members that describe stages, types and plans are objects whose form is in the OxQL documentation.

include.description: What the answer carries beyond the verdict: any of `shape`, `notes`, `types`, `docs`, `plan`, `indexes`.

remote.description: `check` asks the other services a join reaches; `cached` answers from what is already known.

catalog.description: Entities to describe beside the query: objects of `id`, `entity` and optional `prefix`, `depth`, `referencing`.

OxQLExplainBody.description: The body of an explain in its envelope form. A plain query (a body with `entityType` at the top) is accepted as well and is this envelope with its defaults.

depth.description: The levels of member rows, from 1.

OxQLExplainShape.description: The `shape` member of an explain envelope.

id.description: A name of the caller's choice; errors and diagnostics of the entry carry it.

where.description: A condition, as a `match` stage takes it.

path.description: The member whose value is the key.

as.description: The name the key is answered under.

OxQLGroupKey.description: One key of a `group`: a path, or a date truncated to a unit.

by.description: The keys of a group; empty groups all rows into one.

fields.description: The aggregates by the name they are answered under: each an object of one function, such as `{ "count": true }` or `{ "sum": "amount" }`.

status.description: `healthy`, or `degraded` while a service the model joins into is not usable or the model is degraded.

capabilities.description: What depends on the host: joins into other services, explain, contract 1.

limits.description: The limits a request is checked against, by name, with the values in force on this host.

remote.description: The services the host's model joins into; absent with `?shallow=true` and on a host without any.

OxQLHealthAnswer.description: The answer of the health route. A caller without the contract header reads `status`, `service`, `engine`, `capabilities`, `limits` and, per service, `service`, `configured` and `reachable`.

version.description: The version of the engine's packages.

entities.description: How many entities the model has.

degraded.description: Whether the model is what a failed build left.

OxQLHealthModel.description: The state of a host's entity model.

configured.description: Whether the host has an address for it.

reachable.description: Whether it answered the last measurement; null until the first has finished.

contract.description: The contract its engine speaks; contract 2 only.

engineVersion.description: The version of its engine; contract 2 only.

usable.description: Whether joins into it can run; contract 2 only.

reason.description: Why it is not usable; contract 2 only.

references.description: What the host's check of its declared references into the service says; contract 2 only.

OxQLHealthService.description: A service the host's model joins into, as last measured.

from.description: The id of the entity whose records reference the row.

path.description: The member of that entity that holds the reference.

as.description: The name the joined records stand under in the row.

on.description: The alias of an earlier join whose rows are the parents, instead of the row itself.

filter.description: A condition the joined records must meet.

sort.description: The order of the joined records, as a `sort` stage takes it.

limit.description: The most records joined per row.

first.description: Joins the first record as an object instead of an array.

forTarget.description: The target of a reference with several targets that this stage continues under.

parentAs.description: The name the parent of a joined item stands under.

hasNextPage.description: Whether a page follows this one.

nextCursor.description: The cursor of the next page, to send as `page.cursor`; absent on the last page.

OxQLPageInfo.description: The paging metadata of a contract 2 answer.

limit.description: The most rows of the page; the host's default when absent. `0` with `count` asks for the count alone.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the page before, to continue after it.

count.description: Whether to count the matching rows: `true`, `false`, or an object `{ "upTo": n, "budgetMs": ms }` that bounds the count.

items.description: The rows, each an object in the wire encoding of the entity (or `{ value, count }` for a `values` stage).

diagnostics.description: What the caller should know about the rows that did not refuse the request; absent when there is nothing.

timing.description: Where the request's time went; only when the request asked for it.

OxQLQueryAnswer.description: The answer to a query under contract 2: a page of rows and what is known of their count.

entityType.description: The id of the entity, as the service's schema publishes it (`logistics.shipment`).

pipeline.description: The stages, executed as written. Each element is an object with exactly one stage.

variables.description: Named values a condition refers to with `{ "$var": "name" }`.

filter.description: Conditions the engine places where the pipeline has the paths they read; a row must meet all of them.

strict.description: Refuses the request (422) where it would otherwise answer with less data than was asked for.

onMissing.description: What a join does with a reference whose target is missing, unless the join says so itself: `null`, `report` or `refuse`.

timing.description: Asks for the `timing` member of the answer.

maxTimeMs.description: A ceiling on this request's time in milliseconds, under the host's own.

OxQLQueryBody.description: A query: the entity it reads and the stages it reads it through.

path.description: The member of the row that holds the reference.

as.description: The name the joined record stands under in the row.

filter.description: A condition the target must meet.

elements.description: Through a collection: `first` joins one target, `all` one per element.

target.description: The target to join, of a reference that declares several.

parentAs.description: The name the parent of a joined item stands under.

onMissing.description: What to do with a reference whose target is missing: `null`, `report` or `refuse`.

forTarget.description: The target of a reference with several targets that this stage continues under.

byTarget.description: One path per target, for a join that continues under a reference with several targets.

outcomeAs.description: The name of a member that says how the join ended for the row.

match.description: A condition on the rows: paths with operators, nested with `and`, `or`, `not` and `any`.

project.description: The members a row keeps (`1`) or leaves out (`0`), by path; a nested object is a dotted path.

sort.description: The order of the rows: objects of one path each, with `asc` or `desc`.

OxQLStage.description: One stage of a pipeline: exactly one of the members is written.

path.description: The collection whose elements become rows.

as.description: The name the element stands under in the row.

preserveNull.description: Keeps a row whose collection is empty or absent, once, without an element.

includeIndex.description: The name of a member that holds the element's position in the collection.

flatten.description: A member of the element that nests elements of the same kind: they become rows too.

path.description: The path whose distinct values are answered.

search.description: Keeps the values that start with this text.

counts.description: Answers each value with the number of rows that hold it.

scan.description: The most rows read for the list.

name.description: The first segment, e.g. `vehicle-api`.

OxSchemaApi.description: The API base path of a service, as the two segments it is composed from: `/<name>/<version>`.

maxLength.description: The longest string the member accepts.

min.description: The smallest value the member accepts.

max.description: The largest value the member accepts.

pattern.description: A regular expression the member's value satisfies.

OxSchemaConstraints.description: Value constraints of a property. Bounds travel as strings because a JSON number is a double.

since.description: The version the member was deprecated in.

target.description: What the finding is about, in wire terms: an entity id, a pool id, or `entityId#path`.

detail.description: One sentence, including what was dropped as a result.

OxSchemaDiagnostic.description: One thing the build could not describe. Only findings that removed an entity or the whole pool are published; none names a type of the service's code.

OxSchemaDiscriminator.description: The element a stored polymorphic value names its variant in (format 1.1).

schemaVersion.description: The format version of this document.

revision.description: `sha256:` plus the digest of the canonical form with this member absent. It names the content of the document.

diagnostics.description: What the build could not describe. Absent on a clean build, so an incomplete document is distinguishable from an empty service.

types.description: The type pool, entities and structural types in one map keyed by id. The ordinal sort is a rule of the canonical form.

OxSchemaDocument.description: The schema document a service publishes under `GET /schema`: the entities a query can read, every type reachable from them, and the limits a query is checked against.

path.description: A dotted path of wire segments; array traversal is implicit.

aliases.description: The two-part `$Parent.$Child` legacy model ids of this collection; only ids the service's legacy document publishes. Always present, possibly empty.

OxSchemaEntityItem.description: One item collection of an entity: the path that reaches it and its legacy ids.

name.description: The member's name, verbatim as the service declares it.

value.description: The declared value, as a JSON number. A reader must accept a JSON string too.

active.description: False retires a member without breaking historical data.

description.description: A description, when the model declares one (format 1.1).

OxSchemaEnumValue.description: One member of an enum entry.

maxPageSize.description: The largest page a request may ask for.

defaultPageSize.description: The page size a request that names none gets.

maxPipelineStages.description: The longest pipeline the engine accepts, counting every stage.

maxLookupStages.description: How many lookup stages one pipeline may carry.

maxUnwindStages.description: How many unwind stages one pipeline may carry.

maxGroupFields.description: How many fields one group stage may carry.

maxProjectionFields.description: How many fields one projection may name.

regexMaxLength.description: The longest regex pattern a filter operand may carry, in characters.

maxOffset.description: The largest `offset` a page may skip to; beyond it the caller pages by cursor. A grid decides where its jump stops on this.

maxResolveStages.description: How many resolve stages one pipeline may carry.

maxBatchQueries.description: The most queries one batch may carry.

maxLookupLimit.description: The most rows one lookup returns per parent.

maxContinuedStages.description: How many stages a keyed fetch may continue on the service that owns its target (format 1.1).

maxFlattenDepth.description: How many levels an unwind's `flatten` descends below the unwound element (format 1.1).

maxReportPageSize.description: The page size of a strict report request, which names neither a cursor nor an offset (format 1.1). Such a request may ask for the larger of this and `maxPageSize`.

OxSchemaLimits.description: The limits a request has to respect before it is submitted, each read from the query engine that enforces it.

route.description: The route below the service's API base path, e.g. `/Vehicle/{id}`.

OxSchemaOperation.description: One REST operation of an entity: a real HTTP verb and an app-relative route.

name.description: The camelCase wire name. Absent on a nested descriptor.

storageName.description: The name the member is stored and queried under, present only where it is not `name` with its first letter upper-cased. A query uses the wire spelling; this is for consumers that address storage themselves, where the derivation is wrong exactly on acronym runs (`qrCode` is stored as `QRCode`).

type.description: A pointer into the pool, `#/types/<id>`. Present on object and enum kinds.

nullable.description: Whether a client can read null out of the member. Absent on a nested descriptor.

displayName.description: The human label, present only where it is not the de-camelCased `name`, which again is the acronym case (`qrCode` labels as "QR Code", not "Qr Code").

description.description: A description, when the model declares one.

snapshotOf.description: The entity this member is an embedded copy of. Travels with the pointer, so it appears on a nested descriptor too. A copy is never joinable.

values.description: A closed value list. An addon definition descriptor (`GET /schema/addons`) carries the organisation's list with labels. In the schema document only a member that holds one value per variant carries it (`byVariant`): the distinct values, ordinally sorted, without labels, so a reader can offer them as it offers an enum's.

onlyFor.description: The variants of the holding type that carry this member, when not all of them do (format 1.1). A reader treats the member as absent on every other stored value.

referenceCases.description: Every case of a reference that is not simple, in declaration order (format 1.1): a condition, an item target, a key conversion or several targets. Never beside `references`.

stored.description: `false` on a member the service returns and does not store (format 1.1): no row of a query carries it and the query engine refuses every use of it, a projection included, for the member and for everything below it; unless it carries `byVariant`. Absent on a stored member, and on a nested descriptor.

storedAs.description: How the value is stored where its kind does not say it, one of `codePoint`, `document`, `arrayOfDocuments`, `arrayOfArrays` (format 1.1). It travels with the shape, so it appears on a nested descriptor too. Absent: the kind's own representation.

byVariant.description: The value the member holds for each variant of the type it is a member of, by variant name as `variants` and `baseVariant` spell it, ordinally sorted (format 1.1). Only on a member with `stored` `false` that is a constant of the class in every variant: the model's own type member (`type`: `"driver"`). The query engine answers such a member from the stored discriminator and compares it with `eq`, `neq`, `in` and `nin`. Absent on every other member, and on a nested descriptor.

OxSchemaProperty.description: A property descriptor. On a type's property list it describes a member; nested as an array's `of` or a dictionary's `value` it describes a shape and carries no member facts.

field.description: The single path that is the target's key. Absent when the target is not an entity of this document or its key is not one path.

joinable.description: Whether a query may join on this reference.

inferred.description: True when the target was derived from the property name rather than declared.

OxSchemaReference.description: A simple foreign key: one unconditional entity target, no item path, no key conversion. Every other reference is published as `referenceCases` and never here, because a format 1.0 reader maps every `references` to an entity join.

keyAs.description: How the stored value becomes the targets' key; `guid`, or absent for no conversion.

targets.description: The targets, in the order they are tried.

OxSchemaReferenceCase.description: One case of a reference (format 1.1). A case without `when` applies unconditionally.

path.description: The sibling's wire name. Absent on a variant condition.

equals.description: The values the sibling is compared with, exactly. Absent on a variant condition.

variant.description: The variant names the holding object is tested against. Absent on a path condition.

OxSchemaReferenceCondition.description: The condition of a reference case: either a sibling `path` holding one of `equals`, or the holding object being stored as one of `variant`.

entity.description: The target entity id; it may belong to another service.

item.description: The path of the target's array whose element the value names. Absent when the value names the entity itself.

field.description: The path the value matches: on the element when `item` is present, else on the entity.

OxSchemaReferenceTarget.description: One target of a reference case.

name.description: The name of the reference, a wire segment that is unique among the relation names of its type: it lies on the member that carries the reference, or, where `member` is present, on the slot one level above, and is then the name of the reference the slot's key member carries.

member.description: Absent when the name is that of the reference the member itself carries. Otherwise the member is a slot and the name is that of the reference its key member carries: `id` or `referenceId`, written here.

OxSchemaRelation.description: The name of a relation (format 1.1): see `relation`.

kind.description: `enum` on an enum entry; absent on an object entry.

displayName.description: The human label of an entity. Absent on a structural type.

description.description: A description, when the model declares one.

flags.description: Whether an enum entry is a flags enum. Absent on a non-enum entry.

values.description: The value list of an enum entry, in declaration order. Absent on a non-enum entry.

entity.description: True on an entity entry; absent on a structural type.

aliases.description: The ids this entity is also known by: the ids it retired, then the legacy `$ClassName` model ids its controller publishes. Entity-only.

key.description: The property paths that identify an instance. Present on entities and on keyed item types.

display.description: The property that names an instance. Entity-only, absent when no candidate exists.

extendable.description: Whether the entity accepts an organisation's declared addon fields. Entity-only.

queryable.description: True on an entity entry: every entity in the pool is accepted as a query's entity type.

notFilterable.description: Paths the entity refuses to filter on. Entity-only, always present, possibly empty.

notSortable.description: Paths the entity refuses to sort on. Entity-only, always present, possibly empty.

operations.description: The REST operations of an entity by slot (`get`, `create`, `update`, `replace`, `delete`), sorted ordinally. Absent when no linked controller routes any slot.

items.description: Every path under an entity whose terminal is an array of a keyed item type. Entity-only, always present, possibly empty.

properties.description: The property list. Absent on an enum entry; an object entry always carries it, empty included.

variants.description: The concrete types a value of this type can hold besides itself, ordinally by name (format 1.1). The members only some of them carry are on `properties` with `onlyFor`. Absent on a type that has no variants.

baseVariant.description: The name an `is` filter accepts for a value stored as this polymorphic type itself (format 1.1): the type's own name when it is a concrete class. Absent on an abstract class or an interface, whose values are always one of `variants`, and on a type that has no variants.

OxSchemaType.description: One entry of the type pool. An entity is a structural type that additionally carries entity metadata.

value.description: The value, as the bag stores it: a string, or the decimal digits of an int.

label.description: The label shown for the value.

OxSchemaValue.description: One entry of a closed value list.

name.description: The variant's name, the value an `is` filter and an `onlyFor` list use.

type.description: A pointer to the pool entry that describes the variant, `#/types/<id>`.

OxSchemaVariant.description: One variant of a polymorphic type (format 1.1).

loadStart.description:
Gets or sets the load time slot start with date and time

This will define the start of the time range the driver could start the loading process.
This will usually be set by the user or an api based on the values he gets from customer.

loadEnd.description:
Gets or sets the load time slot end with date and time.

This will define the end of the time range the driver could end the loading process.
This will usually be set by the user or an api based on the values he gets from the customer.

plannedLoadStart.description:
Gets or sets the planned laod start with date and time.

This will define the planned start of the loading process.
This will usually be set by the user based on his dayplan for the resource.

plannedLoadEnd.description:
Gets or sets the planned load end with date and time.

This will define the planned end of the loading process.
This will usually be set by the user based on his dayplan for the resource.

calculatedLoadStart.description:
Gets or sets the calculated load start with date and time.

This will define the calculated / theoretical start of the loading process.
This will usually be set by an api based on data given by the telematics.

calculatedLoadEnd.description:
Gets or sets the calculated load end with date and time.

This will define the calculated / theoretical end of the laoding process.
This will usually be set by an api based on data given by the telematics.

actualLoadStart.description:
Gets or sets the actual laod start with date and time.

This will define the actual start of the loading process.
This will usually be set by an api based on the data given by the telematics.

actualLoadEnd.description:
Gets or sets the actual load end with date and time.

This will define the actual end of the loading process.
This will usually be set by an api based on the data given by the telematics

deliveryStart.description:
Gets or sets the delivery time slot start with date and time.

This will define the start of the time range when the driver could deliver the shipment.
This will usually be set by the user or an api based on the values he gets from the customer.

deliveryEnd.description:
Gets or sets the delivery time slot end with date and time.

This will define the end of the time range when the driver could deliver the shipment.
This will usually be set by the user or an api based on the values he gets from the customer.

plannedDeliveryStart.description:
Gets or sets the planned delivery start with date and time.

This defines the planned start of the delivery / unloading process.
This will usually be set by the user based on his dayplan of the resource.

plannedDeliveryEnd.description:
Gets or sets the planned delivery end with date and time.

This defines the planned end off the delivery / unlaoding process.
This will usually be set by the user based on his dayplan of the resource.

calculatedDeliveryStart.description:
Gets or sets the calculated delivery start with date and time.

This defines the calculated start of the delivery / unlaoding process.
This will usually be set by an api based on telematics data.

calculatedDeliveryEnd.description:
Gets or sets the calculated delivery end with date and time.

This defines the calculated end of the delivery / unlaoding process.
This will usually be set by an api based on telematics data.

actualDeliveryStart.description:
Gets or sets the actual delivery start with date and time.

This defines the actual start of the delivery / unlaoding process.
This will usually be set by an api based on telematics data.

actualDeliveryEnd.description:
Gets or sets the actual delivery end with date and time.

This defines the actual end of the delivery / unlaoding process.
This will usually be set by an api based on telematics data.

orderDate.description:
Gets or sets the order date.

This defines the date the shipment is ordered at.
This is a relevant information for the billing process and needs to be set.

shipmentNumber.description:
Gets or sets the shipment number.

This defines a number to identify the shipment as the user.

referenceNumber.description:
Gets or sets the reference number

This defines a number that references the same shipment in another programm or context.

loadNumber.description:
Gets or sets the load number.

This defines a number that the driver might need to load this shipment

deliveryNumber.description:
Gets or sets the delivery number.

This defines a number that the driber might need to deliver / unload this shipment.

isTemplate.description:
Gets or sets werther the shipment is a template.

Template shipments are used to create shipments with certain values preset.

templateName.description:
Gets or sets the template name.

A name for the template to give the user the option to find it easier

tags.description:
Gets or sets the tags.

Tags are short texts to add information to a shipment without the need to add new properties.
These are e.g. used in the pricing module to add some additional conditions.

notes.description:
Gets or sets the notes.

This gives the user the possibillity to add some more sentences about this shipment.

externalNotes.description: Gets or sets the external notes.

loadWorkflowId.description:
Gets or sets the load workflow.

Represents a telematic workflow that can be set to give the driver 
additional instructions during the loading process.
Usually these workflows need to be enabled and added within their telematic system.

deliveryWorkflowId.description:
Gets or sets the delivery workflow.

Represents a telematic workflow that can be set to give the driver 
additional instructions during the delivery / unload process.
Usually these workflows need to be enabled and added within their telematic system.
